{{Top|leg}}
The '''Secretary of War''' was the title given to a member of the [[Allied Cabinet]] within an [[Allied Command]]. Each Allied Cabinet maintained the position of Secretary of War. Their position was analogous to the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of War]] on the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]].
